title: Andhra Chicken Curry
description: A spicy and flavourful Andhra-style chicken curry with onions, tomatoes and aromatic spices.

steps.title: SautÃ© the onions
steps.text: Heat oil in a pan. Add the onions and sautÃ© until golden brown.

steps.title: Add the chicken and spices
steps.text: Add ginger-garlic paste, chicken, chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric and salt. Stir well.

steps.title: Simmer the curry
steps.text: Add tomatoes and a splash of water. Cover and simmer until the chicken is completely cooked through.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Add garam masala. Garnish and serve hot with rice or roti.

tips: Adjust red chilli powder to your spice preference.
For best flavour, let the curry rest for 10 minutes before serving.
